newsitem.title: USA: Damen unit to convert to national bank.
newsitem.headline: Damen unit to convert to national bank.

text.p: Damen Financial Corp said Friday its Damen Federal Bank for Savings subsidiary received conditional approval to convert its charter to a national bank from a federal savings bank.
It said approval came from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency.

"The adoption of a national bank charter is an important part of the bank's effort to restructure its products and services to meet the challenges of an evolving marketplace," said president Mary Beth Poronsky Stull in a statement.
